[!dolt] skip
# Test bd query handles boolean filters and JSON output
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Urgent login bug' --description 'OAuth login fails' --type bug --priority 0 --labels urgent,backend
bd create 'Routine cleanup' --description 'Delete old temp files' --type chore --priority 3
extractid CHORE
bd close $CHORE --reason Done

bd query 'type=bug AND label=urgent' --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^1$'
jq '.[0].issue.title'
stdout '"Urgent login bug"'

bd query 'NOT status=closed' --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^1$'

bd query 'status=closed' --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^1$'

! bd query 'status==='
stderr 'parsing query'
